The '''Annaj system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] in [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]], part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]].<ref name="SWGM9" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]] retreated and regrouped in the Annaj system.<ref name="TRUCE">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>
